Why Bloomwell

Started in a kitchen, formulated with dermatologists

Bloomwell began as a handful of small-batch serums mixed on a kitchen counter for a founder tired of ingredient lists she couldn't pronounce. Every formula since has followed the same rule: a short list of actives, at concentrations that actually do something, reviewed by a dermatologist before it ever reaches a bottle.

Centella Asiatica

A botanical extract traditionally used to calm irritated skin and support the skin barrier. In Bloomwell formulas it's used to reduce visible redness after cleansing or exfoliation.

Best for: redness & sensitivity
